title: Public Law 119-46: Requesting the Secretary of the Interior to authorize unique and one-time arrangements for displays…
summary: H.J.Res. 133, "Requesting the Secretary of the Interior to authorize unique and one-time arrangements for displays on the National Mall and the Washington Monument during the period beginning on December 31, 2025, and ending on January 5, 2026.", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-46 on 2025-12-02, according to Congress.gov.
